digest.component_or_area: LLM usage logging and plan-review budget tracking
propositions: usage_log.record() must capture model, provider, and UTC ISO timestamp alongside token counts to enable accurate per-row cost calculation from genai-prices data
summarize() must read stored JSONL rows and compute per-op and per-model cost totals via genai-prices when available, with graceful fallback when the package is absent or pricing lookups fail

The dict-to-kwargs adapter must map all four token fields (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens) from stored row dicts to genai_prices calc_price calls, defaulting missing fields to 0
Pricing errors (LookupError for unknown models, exceptions from calc_price) must never break summarize; affected rows are marked unpriced and the summary reports the exclusion count
Old format usage-log rows without the new fields (model, provider, timestamp) must still be readable and summarizable without error
The optional genai-prices dependency and its error paths must be covered by unit tests; the summary output must label costs as estimated and note when pricing data is unavailable
